offer.text: The chef wants pufferfish for a fancy dish — risky eating, that. Land me 2 without poisoning yourself.

accept.text: Handle them with care. They puff up for a reason.

decline.text: Safer choice, honestly. But less coin.

ready.text: Two puffers, and all your fingers intact! Impressive.

complete.text: The chef will make something extraordinary. Well earned.
